main.title: A web design studio in manchester
main.description:
Here at MadeByShape, we offer honest advice, industry experience, and a great portfolio of work. 

 UI/UX, wireframes, research and development — we understand all areas of web design. We can take a start-up business with nothing to a fully functioning brand online and offline. We can revamp an existing website or take a successful brand to the next level. Our talented and creative in-house web design team in Manchester will work alongside you in collaboration to create a site that reflects your brand, talks to your audience with meaning and personality, and has great functionality across the latest devices.

explanation.fewWords: We approach every project with a clear vision.
explanation.title: We like to remove the 'waffle' and design beautiful, easy to use websites that are functional.
explanation.description: We don't just build pretty websites. Here at MadeByShape, we understand all aspects of a successful site, from design through web development and testing, to SEO and Hosting. We tailor our service to the client and the project requirements.

inhouse.title: We handle every project in-house, we don't outsource.
inhouse.description: We're a strong team of 16, we know how much work we can take on, and we let clients know if there will be a delay. Every website project we take on is produced in-house, with no outsourcing involved. If we feel we're not the right fit for your project, we will use our digital industry experience to recommend a suitable agency for you. Our team of brand designers, web designers, and content writers work together to give you the perfect solution.
